maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: we saw recurring token-growth on a family of prompts. Need owners for tests and alerts.
jess: I can own a tiny prompt regression suite (8 cases, 5 seeds). Will add pass/fail on token-growth >2x. ETA Fri COB.
rohan: I'll extend the k6 load scenario to include KV cold->hot transitions and a 10s ramp to 400 RPS. Target: 95th <300ms. ETA next Tue.
kevin: I'll own a chaos drill to simulate a GPU OOM and verify fallback to low-memory model within 10s. Need telemetry events for verification.
maria: Who wires a CI alert for the incident prompt set so we get automatic paging?
jess: I'll add a metric `prompt_regression_rate{case="repeat-stop"}` and a Grafana rule: page if >5% across two consecutive CI runs.
kevin: I'll link PRs to PM-432 and add a short verification checklist for runs.
rohan: Note: repro only when prompts include repeated stop tokens. I'll add `prompts/incidents/repeat-stop.json` to the cases.
ci-bot: New PR by jess: https://git.redwood/evals/pulls/158 (regress harness + cases)
maria: Recap: jess (regress) Fri; rohan (load) Tue; kevin (chaos) 2w. Update PM-432 with PR links in 48h. Schedule 30m drill next Fri 10:00am.
jess: :thumbsup:
kevin: lgtm
rohan: thanks all
